lines.dialogue: "Won't be able to keep the farm these wolves keep being a nuisance."
"Filthy mutts need to stop bothering the livestock."
"We all appreciate your help with the wolves."
"Aren't you supposed to be killing some wolves or something?"
"I've heard of dangerous caves full of wolves deeper in the woods. I'd avoid going too far off the trail if I were you."
"Aren't you supposed to be killing some wolves or something?"
"I don't have time to talk. Wolves keep bothering my livestock."
